# openobserve_alert_destinations (Data Source)

Lists the alert destinations of an OpenObserve organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_alert_destinations" "all" {}

output "email_destinations" {
  value = [for d in data.openobserve_alert_destinations.all.destinations : d.name if d.type == "email"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) The destinations found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `id` (String) Data source ID.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String) HTTP method used for webhook delivery.
- `name` (String) Destination name.
- `template` (String) Template used to render the message.
- `type` (String) Delivery channel.
- `url` (String) Webhook URL.
